toolchain.tinygo_0_42: Compiles, but does not unwind Wasm panics; not supported for SDK resource guarantees.
toolchain.self_hosted_ci: not-verified: updated workflow has not executed on self-hosted runners
toolchain.network_scheduler: asyncify (TinyGo default); database panic/transaction guarantees do not apply
toolchain.tarawasm_source: Git master with native TinyGo 0.43 and managed Binaryen 133 support

compression.scenario: flate, gzip, zlib, crc32, adler32; compile and runtime

dns.runtime: localhost resolves to a loopback address
dns.limitation: TinyGo hook returns the first resolved address

tcp.scenario: Echo, partial reads, EOF, read deadline, concurrent close, repeated connections in one component, keepalive hooks and reset under write backpressure

http.transport: Go net/http over optional WASI TCP driver

tls.runtime: network: operation not supported (adapter explicitly rejects TLS sockets)

external_https.reason: No external service in reproducible tests.

go_range_functions.reason: SDK uses explicit synchronous iterator helpers.

network_policy.scenario: Host DNS, TCP, IP and port restrictions enforced

network_imports.scenario: Network component emits WASI 0.2.12 sockets and streams; base component has no sockets, callbacks, host zlib or TLS imports; unstable network-error-code is not imported

ipv6_tcp.reason: Runtime TCP fixtures use IPv4 loopback; IPv6 conversion is implemented

network_deadlines.reason: Options.Timeout bounds each DNS/connect operation; TinyGo does not forward Dialer contexts/deadlines or changes to deadlines during pending I/O

network_build_modes.scenario: Archive-installed SDK: DNS, TCP and HTTP compiled and executed through tarawasm and direct wit-bindgen-go/TinyGo builds

lua_server_after_wasm_dns.reason: On the checked macOS host, immediate Lua coio server creation after a Wasm DNS export could time out; test controller yields once before setup. Host runtime unchanged.

http_timeout.scenario: TinyGo 0.43 Client.Timeout does not bound HTTP I/O; delayed local server responds after the configured timeout. Options.Timeout bounds DNS/connect only.

http_transport_error_cleanup.reason: Some TinyGo transport error paths do not close the connection; host handles remain until wasm.drop.
